verdict.rationale: Highnote's evidence covers issuing scoped payment cards per agent with spend/velocity controls, but this is a financial-transaction spend-control mechanism, not API credential scoping (e.g., API keys/tokens with least-privilege permissions for programmatic access). There is no mention of scoped API keys, OAuth tokens, or role-based API credentials for agents to call Highnote's own API. missing for 10: evidence of scoped/least-privilege API credential or token issuance for agents accessing the Highnote API itself, permission/role management for API keys, documentation of API-level access control distinct from card spend controls.
